name: PottoTools MCP Server
description: Client-side privacy-first PDF, document, and image processing tools for AI agents and users. 100% in-browser processing via WebAssembly.

resources.name: LLMs Summary
resources.description: Concise Markdown directory of all tools and features.

resources.name: Full LLM Documentation
resources.description: Complete Markdown guide of tools, inputs, formats, and browser guarantees.

tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Reduce PDF file sizes down to strict targets such as 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, or custom KB targets with zero server uploads.

fileUrl.description: URL or data URI of the PDF file to compress

tools.name: merge_pdf
tools.description: Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file with custom sequence ordering.

files.description: Array of PDF file URLs or data URIs in merge order

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF document into separate files by page ranges or individual pages.

fileUrl.description: URL or data URI of the PDF file

tools.name: pdf_to_word
tools.description: Convert PDF files into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) documents preserving layout, text, tables, and photos.

fileUrl.description: URL or data URI of the PDF file to convert

tools.name: custom_photo_studio
tools.description: Resize, crop, straighten, color adjust, compress to target KB, and convert image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP) in a single workflow.

imageUrl.description: URL or data URI of the image

targetKB.description: Optional target file size in KB

tools.name: ocr_scanner
tools.description: Extract text from scanned PDFs, photos, and receipts using in-browser Optical Character Recognition supporting English and Hindi.

fileUrl.description: URL or data URI of the image or scanned PDF
